name: luxury-closet-selfie-with-dog
image_purpose: Create a casual but polished walk-in-closet mirror selfie with a calm companion dog.

prompt.project_info: Photorealistic 4K mirror selfie adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original woman with brown hair and blonde face-framing highlights in a low bun, playful pout, gold hoops, bracelet and white manicure; wearing a fitted black spaghetti-strap dress with a square neckline and short but opaque hem.
prompt.composition_elements: Subject kneels comfortably on a light wood floor holding a tan smartphone; a small fluffy merle dog with a red-pink collar stands calmly beside her. Full-length mirror, folded clothing, hanging garments, white shelving and generic shopping bags fill the walk-in closet.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright diffused indoor lighting, soft shadows, clear mirror reflection, neutral beige, wood and white palette with black outfit contrast; calm lifestyle mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Eye-level mirror selfie, 4K photorealistic detail, sharp focus, realistic textures and accurate reflection geometry.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic 4K walk-in-closet mirror selfie of a clearly adult original woman with brown hair and blonde face-framing highlights in a low bun, wearing an opaque fitted black dress, kneeling comfortably beside a calm small merle dog with a red-pink collar, light wood floor, organized wardrobe, white shelving and generic shopping bags, bright diffused light and accurate reflection.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, identifiable celebrity photo, logos, text, watermark, distressed animal, unsafe animal interaction, distorted hands, broken reflection
